facts.fact: RTD reports President Guelleh inaugurated the private TO7 Network technology park, put into service that day, which includes a data centre hosting IT equipment and data for all digital sectors, in partnership with Wingu Africa.

systems.system: TO7 Network technology park data centre

facts.fact: RTD reports the TO7 park's submarine cable landing station, with room for up to 5 cables, was put into service on 25 November 2024 and serves as the landing platform for a Google cable.

DJI.note: The document names the owner as private TO7 Network but does not say whether it is owned in Djibouti.
The park is a cable landing station and data centre; no startup hosting, programme or tenants are stated.
